player_prompt.intro:
O wena ke Mmotshameki {player_id} mo go {num_rounds}-raundi ya IteratedTwoThirdsAverage.
Ka nako ya raundi nngwe le nngwe, o tshwantsha nambari kwa gare ga {min_guess} le {max_guess}.
Morago ga ditshwantsho tse pedi, seletswa ke (2/3)x(palamo ya ditshwantsho tse pedi),
le motshameki yo o tshwantshang ka bogaufi jwa seletswa o wetsa raundi eo.
Araba ka tshwantsho ya gago ka tsela ya '[<number>]'.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Ga e a siama; tsweetswee romela kakanyo ya gago jaaka [<number>].
invalid_move.out_of_range: Go fopholetsa go tshwanetse ga nna fa gare ga {min_guess} le {max_guess}.

message.round_guesses: Mmotshameki 0 o tshwantshitse {guess0}; Mmotshameki 1 o tshwantshitse {guess1}. Ka jalo, Seletswa ke: {target}.
message.round_draw: Go dikologa go dira gore re se ka ra fenya.

outcome.p0_wins: Motshameki 0 o ne a fenya metshameko e le mentsi.
outcome.p1_wins: Motshameki wa ntlha o ne a fenya metshameko e le mentsi.
